statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ), 0<q → (∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), ‖∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q), f r*E ((a:ℝ)*(r:ℝ)/q)‖^2) ≤ (q:ℝ)*(∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q), ‖f r‖^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖第三批 · FR-9012 · 用加法 Parseval 控制既约分子上的误差平方和
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage III · FR-9012 · Bound phase errors over reduced numerators by additive Parseval

brief.zh: 把单位类上的误差零延拓，再把输出频率扩大到全部剩余类。Parseval 给出 q 因子。这个因子与实际弧宽的 1/q 抵消。
brief.en: Extend the errors by zero on nonunits and sum over all output residues. Parseval supplies the factor q, which cancels the 1/q in the arc width.
